name: dev-kit
description: Plan-driven autonomous dev loop: /write-plan decomposes designs into one-verify tasks (1-2 tests + their implementation, roughly 5-10min; PLAN.md) with TDD enforcement (tier=standard: new-test-required, side-effect-free verify commands), /execute-plan runs tier-routed builders (builder/sonnet with two-phase [red]/[green] TDD dispatch committed separately, red failure confirmed by an orchestrator-run verify; builder-light/haiku) -> orchestrator verify gate (verify re-run before every review; failures never reach the reviewer and are logged as FAIL(verify-gate); auto-run restricted to package/build-script commands with destructive patterns banned) -> reviewer(read-only incl. no Bash-mediated edits; verdict-only fixed output with a requirement traceability table demanding measured evidence -- next-task briefing authored by the orchestrator; inputs limited to task line + diff + gate result + project CLAUDE.md; risk:high tasks reviewed by opus upfront) per task, plus stage-reviewer integration review at stage boundaries (briefing-excerpt inputs only), a conditional plan-approval gate for large plans (8+ tasks / 3+ stages / 5+ new files / schema-external-API-dependency changes; thresholds overridable), with PROGRESS.md + per-task git commit logging, RESUME checkpoint blocks (stage boundaries + PreCompact hook flush), and file-based pause (.dev-kit-pause). Prompt-cache preservation: no CLAUDE.md edits mid-loop, CLAUDE.md-mutating tasks pinned to stage end, same tier/risk tasks ordered adjacently. Parallel [P] groups run in per-task git worktrees (opt-in via project worktree: declaration, default off -> sequential) with a post-merge integration verify gate. Ships a PreToolUse hook that denies destructive Bash commands (DROP/TRUNCATE/rm -rf/git reset --hard/docker volume rm), the entire revert category (git checkout <path>/restore/clean/stash/rm/branch -D/reflog expire; branch switching and -b allowed), and out-of-scope Edit/Write via .dev-kit-scope (per-project exceptions via .dev-kit-allow-destructive), plus a harden skill for evidence-backed environment hardening (DB privileges, backups, dev/prod isolation). Includes brainstorming/grill/docs skills plus systematic debugging (root-cause-first, reproduce->isolate->trace->fix) and repo self-audit, with strict/flexible discipline tagging.
